220360101.text: This business is so hard. All my merchandise is good and they're the real deal...

220360102.text: But why does no one here want to buy anything?

220360104.text: Oh, it's you, Traveler. *sigh* Forget it. I still cannot sell any fertilizer...

220360105.text: Don't you have Alrani to help you?

220360106.text: She did help me out a little. But trouble is, neither of us knows how to promote these goods. We can only wait for the customers to show up...

220360107.text: And you know about the situation in Ritou. Nobody is buying anything.

220360108.text: So I visited the gentlemen at the merchant guild to ask for help, and they suggested that we do something called marketing.

220360109.text: Simply put, they want us to talk more about the fertilizer's effects and the theory behind it with customers. We should also do more data-driven promotion, and we should offer a "free trial" service...

220360110.text: But... I really don't understand such complex matters. And I'm not the one who created this fertilizer, so how can I possibly explain it?

220360111.text: Anyway, even if it's just reciting the instructions, I believe I'll still need to run around and do some promotion.

220360112.text: Alrani is already out there promoting our goods. I am going out later as well. Traveler, could you please help us out?

220360114.text: Excellent! We are counting on you, Traveler.

220360115.text: The place you are going to is called Konda Village. It's not far from here.

220360119.text: There is a gentleman named Konda Densuke who has shown some interest in our fertilizer. He also came to the store to chat with me a little earlier.

220360120.text: If you could promote some of our goods at his place and offer him a free trial, he might just buy some fertilizer.

220360117.text: She said that she needed to collect some materials and that she'll have to go quite far away.

220360118.text: The place you are going to is called Konda Village. It's not far from here.

220360201.text: So, tell me how to use the fertilizer...

220360202.text: Oh yes, right, I haven't explained it to you yet. The fertilizer you are taking there must be used in a certain way.

220360203.text: Now, let me see... according to the manual, the order should be...

220360204.text: You must first add <color=#37FFFF>water</color> to the fertilizer, before adding some <color=#37FFFF>crushed leaves</color>. Finally, <color=#37FFFF>mix them well</color> and apply it to the field.

220360205.text: Don't get the order wrong, or it may cause problems, which will affect our customers' impression of us. Our future business is at stake...

220360207.text: Then I'm counting on you. Once you deliver the Anahitian Blessing to the customer, his first payment will be yours to keep.

220360210.text: I'm counting on you, Traveler... Let's all work hard. With any luck, business this month might be good!

220360501.text: Youngsters, we meet again. What would you like to know this time?

220360505.text: I heard about a novel fertilizer shop in Ritou. That's why I went to meet Mr. Vahid to try out his fertilizer.

220360506.text: If it works and increases crop production, there might be hope for restoring Konda Village.

220360507.text: Heh, I guess it is still up to an old relic such as myself to restore the village. Those young lads from the village... Hmph! You can't count on them.

220360508.text: Alright, tell me then. How should I use this fertilizer?

220360601.text: That's what Vahid told me last time, too. It should be alright. I'll wait for the crops to grow.

220360701.text: I've got a bad feeling about this somehow. It doesn't sound like what Vahid said last time. Are you sure there won't be any problems?
